title: replay state updated before KeyChange validation completes
description: Lines 671-682: replay window marked before line 696 validation. KeyChange error consumes seqnum slot, blocking legitimate retry after unpin.
close_reason: Fixed: Added two-phase replay protection (check() then commit()) to Rust LinkLayer. Replay floor is now committed only AFTER all validation passes, preventing KeyChange error from consuming seqnum slots and blocking legitimate retries after unpin.
